beats.headline: The statement read out on air
beats.text: Subject is the crown prince, brother to the Maestro, a coarse-haired boar-like creature with lean muscle and a manner that is meant to be read as cruelty and largely succeeds. When his empire fires on a trailer and takes someone who was nobody’s enemy, it is his statement that goes out on air. He recorded it before the shot was fired, with an army drilling in the window behind him, announcing an execution that had not happened and, as it turned out, did not.

beats.headline: An arrow, mid-sentence
beats.text: Subject remained in his seat through the pus bomb that burst the blob beside Carl, and used the quiet afterwards to tell Cascadia the mudskippers are a disgrace and everything is falling apart. He got as far as "At least my security" before a sizzling blue magical arrow sprouted from his eye and he fell forward onto the table. Minutes earlier Juice Box had worn his face with an arrow in one eye and promised him the other. Carl has no idea who fired this one. His feed blinks and shuts off. Everyone gets until tomorrow to regenerate.

beats.headline: The crown, and the punch
beats.text: King Stalwart comes to the council in a glittering golden crown, and Donut and Ferdinand, who bet a gold piece on exactly that, fall into hysterics. Every warlord at the table glares at him as though he were something foul dropped in front of them. When Chaco calls a vote on whether he looks stupid in it, Stalwart stands up and punches him in the face, and it lands. They really are in the same room. Chaco slides across it, out cold, and blinks away. Donut asks if she is able to vote.

beats.headline: My sister was right
beats.text: Crawler Carl lands in the woods to find the leader of the Skull Empire on his knees in a clearing, beside Elle McGibbons's open portal. He had reportedly been piloting a scorpion tank Florin guessed at seven hundred tons, had teleported out through a breached net, and his war mages had come with him, four of them already dead from Princess Donut's missiles. Three of the others chanted in unison and his flesh began to tear. He met the crawler's eyes and said, "My sister was right." Then he exploded, all over the clearing.
